title: Weekend Cove Cleanup
meetingPoint: Top of the Cove Lane stairs
description: We work the tide line from the stairs to the north rocks. Bring a water bottle; we bring the rest.

site.name: Driftwood Cove
site.parking: Street parking on Cove Lane; arrive early.
site.description: A small cove where winter storms leave driftwood, rope and fishing gear tangled at the tide line.

image.alt: A small curved cove with pale sand, gray driftwood logs along the tide line and dark rocks at each end.
